Customer Flow Technology

Digital Take-a-Ticket System

A two-screen solution designed to organize queues and make waiting easier for visitors and staff.

Screen 1 — Take a Ticket

Visitors select a service and take a digital ticket. A QR code lets them use their phone to see how many people are ahead of them.

Screen 2 — Now Serving

A separate display shows the current ticket number, the next customer being called and the service counter or station.

Scan Your Ticket. Follow Your Place in Line.

Customers can scan their ticket’s QR code and check how many people are ahead of them from their phone.

Concept illustration of the customer experience. Screens and ticket details are examples, not a live system.
